ItemID: unavailable; Title: Tuck Tape Construction Sheathing Tape, Epoxy Resin Tape, 2.4 in x 180 ft (Red); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have used repair tape, but I have no apparent need for sheathing or resin tape right now.
